notes.title: Index 2 Now Available
notes.content:
Hello, arcology citizens!

The next major content update, Index 2, is now available. This update represents the next 35% of XVTM, and picks up where the previous release, Index 1, left off.

It adds a further five and a half hours of playable content per storyline path, several new achievements, and includes numerous bug fixes and tweaks to existing content.

Whether you’re a new player or are coming from the previous release, please be sure to read through the stickied forum posts for extra information before jumping in:

[list][*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2803990/discussions/0/4199112724335163310/]Frequently Asked Questions About the Game[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2803990/discussions/0/6989114975918391296/]Frequently Asked Questions About Early Access[/url]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2803990/discussions/0/592895838866403032/]Known Issues in the Current Build (v0.66.01)[/url][/list]
As always, thank you for your support, and feel free to post on the forums if you have any questions, run into issues, or have feedback you’d like to share.

-LCN

notes.title: XVTM is now available in Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44871600/a28800c5e306af641f0f5d4563bdd1b7bd8aed95.png[/img]
Good morning arcology citizens, and welcome to the start of Early Access for XVTM!

This initial release, version 0.33.01, is now live and contains about the first 35% of the total game. In addition, several quality of life improvements have been added if you’re coming from the demo, including:

[list]
[*] Achievements
[*] Improved text readability
[*] Autosave and Cloud Save
[*] Optimized on-disk size
[/list]
Be sure to look through the Early Access Questions and Answers on the XVTM Store Page, as well as the stickied Early Access FAQ thread in the XVTM Discussion Forums for more information.

Thanks, and please enjoy your time in 2989!

-LCN
